q.description: Search query string. Must not be empty.

lang.description: Target language index for routing. Replaces language[] in v2. When zh-both, page is limited to 5 (enforced by backend, not schema).

mode.description: Search mode. knn/hybrid require embedding service; falls back to bm25 if unavailable.

page.description: Page number, 1-based. For lang=zh-both, backend enforces page <= 5.

language.description: @deprecated Since v2. Use lang instead. Ignored by backend in v2; will be removed in Phase 2.
